rules.accepted_credit_types: AMA PRA Category 1 from ACCME-accredited or ACCME-recognized providers; AOA Category 1 from AOA-accredited providers; AAFP Prescribed and approved Elective credit; Royal College (Canada) Section 1; other courses approved by the board as equivalent
rules.new_licensee_rule: Not required before the first renewal of a regular permanent license. Licensed more than one but less than two full years at first reporting: 20 hours.
rules.alternatives: Exempt: current ABMS, AOA or Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada certification, MOC or recertification at the time of the CME audit; residents/fellows in ACGME/AOA programs; locum tenens/special licenses; fully retired physicians (affidavit). Extension or waiver for illness or extenuating circumstances.
rules.audit_note: Compliance questions on the renewal form; documents only if requested. The board audits randomly selected physicians.
rules.notes: One board licenses MDs and DOs. 40 hours every two years (rule amended April 1, 2024). The board website ndbom.org did not respond (timeout); data from the North Dakota Administrative Code.
